bioconda.name: dimont
bioconda.summary: Dimont and SlimDimont (Slim, LSlim) de-novo motif discovery for ChIP-seq and PBM data
bioconda.description:
Dimont is a universal tool for discriminative de-novo motif discovery of
transcription factor binding sites from high-throughput data such as
ChIP-seq, ChIP-exo and protein-binding microarrays (PBM). Motifs are
modelled as position weight matrices (PWM) or inhomogeneous Markov models.

SlimDimont extends Dimont with Slim (sparse local inhomogeneous mixture)
and LSlim models, which capture neighbouring and non-neighbouring
dependencies between motif positions. Dependency logos, motif scanning
and genome-wide binding site prediction are provided as well.

Both tools are part of the Jstacs Java library. This package installs the
authors' command line programs, which take key=value arguments exactly as
documented on the Jstacs web site: dimont, slimdimont, dimont-predictor,
slimdimont-predictor and dimont-genomescan, plus dimont-cli, the multi-tool
interface that also includes sequence extraction, motif scanning and
QuickScan binding site prediction. JVM options such as -Xmx4G may be given
before the tool arguments.
